about: The role policy set (§8.1): the same topic questions asked by every role. The tutor's four roles (STUDENT, TEACHER, FACULTY, HOD) are answered; every other school role gets the one sentence saying whom the tutor is for (TUTOR_NOT_FOR_ROLE), never a topic answer. EXPERT and RECRUITER have no assistant at all (the doors' NO_SCHOOL, checked in the pilot).
